# Magnitude_Phase_Complex_Neural_Network

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A unified complex-valued neural network framework that separately processes magnitude and phase components of complex signals for enhanced representational capacity. Enables richer signal processing in neuromorphic systems, particularly for applications involving oscillatory or phase-encoded neural data.
